title: Several of relay's own senders still signal without a…
what: bin/check:50: MEDIUM: F4 several of relay's own senders still signal without a line in the signal log, so 'not sent by relay' is not a proof
why: Several of relay's own senders (bin/check, templates/bin-check, lib/relay_precheck.py, lib/relay_gate_ssh.py, lib/relay_gate_remote.py, tests/parallel_unittest.py) still send signals without a line in the signal log, so the gate's 'not sent by relay' is not yet a proof.
failing_case: The queue item: "Every place relay itself sends SIGTERM or SIGKILL (hang bounds, the leftover sweep, test-token waits,
gate stops) writes one line". Not recorded today: bin/check stop_group (SIGTERM then SIGKILL, the worker's hang bound,
bin/check:50,57); lib/relay_precheck.py:139 (SIGKILL, the types-lint time limit); lib/relay_gate_ssh.py:216,232
(terminate/kill, the remote gate's backstop); lib/relay_gate_remote.py:75,176 (SIGKILL of the build and the command);
tests/parallel_unittest.py:270 (kill of a worker after 600 s); templates/bin-check:44,51 (the projects' bin/check).
A process ended by any of them is reported as "not sent by relay".
pass_cases: 1. bin/check with CHECK_TIMEOUT=1 on a step that sleeps: the signal log gains "sent SIGTERM to group <step pid>: bin/check: the step passed its time bound".
2. relay_precheck's types-lint time limit: a SIGKILL line naming the precheck step.

3. git grep for os.kill( / os.killpg( / .terminate() / .kill() with a real signal in lib/, bin/, templates/, tests/*.py helpers shows each one next to a record_sent (or through relay_procs.send); os.kill(pid, 0) probes and the gate's re-raise to itself excepted.
4. The new test_gate_stops tests keep passing.
